data.title: $1m bounties, dawn arrests: Trump presses voter fraud campaign
data.description: LOS ANGELES — As the United States heads toward November's midterms, US President Donald Trump and Republicans are issuing increasingly dire warnings of voter fraud, while Democrats and voting-rights activists mobilise against what they call a campaign of intimidation designed to scare people away from the ballot box.

data.title: Benjamin Netanyahu: Israel's longest-serving PM fighting for survival
data.description: JERUSALEM — Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Israel's consummate political survivor, faces the fight of his life in Tuesday's election as he tries to convince voters he is still the only candidate capable of keeping them safe.

data.title: Betagro drives sustainable food future with 25% Scope 3 reduction roadmap towards 2050
data.description: BANGKOK, Oct 26, 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, reinforced its leadership in sustainable food production at its annual sustainability forum, “Betagro SD Day 2026”, held under the theme “Sustainable Food through Net Zero.”

data.title: HK Express passenger injured after power bank overheats on flight to Jeju
data.description: A traveller was injured after a power bank overheated and emitted smoke aboard an HK Express flight from Hong Kong to South Korea on Sunday, prompting crew members to deploy emergency safety measures before the aircraft landed safely.

data.title: Kane beats Yamal and Mbappe to taste Ballon d'Or glory
data.description: LONDON - Harry Kane became England's first Ballon d'Or winner in 25 years in his native city of London on Monday, beating out stiff competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappe.

data.title: US-brokered truce begins in Ukraine city occupied by Russia
data.description: KYIV, Ukraine - A truce between Ukraine and Russia aimed at allowing humanitarian aid into the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky entered into force early on Tuesday, having been announced by US First Lady Melania Trump last week.

data.title: SCB denies Tawan-Oil Trading ever held account with bank
data.description: Siam Commercial Bank says Tawan-Oil Trading has never held an account, conducted transactions or had a business relationship with the bank.

data.title: 'The Human Idea' offering cash prizes for bright sparks
data.description: Leading property developer AP Thailand and Adapter Digital invite creative thinkers and university students to join "The Human Idea – Creative Sprint 2026" to vie for cash prizes worth over 1.2 million baht.

data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on. ✨= today's motto,⏰ = work, ₿ = money, ❤️= taken, ⚤ = single

data.title: Rethinking relief food
data.description: Last November, Hat Yai woke up to water. Heavy downpours for multiple days and flash floods submerged Songkhla and other southern provinces. Some managed to evacuate in time, while others were left stranded.

data.title: Makeup as an object to wear
data.description: Since her appointment in 2024, Sarah Burton has been shaping a vision of Givenchy that brings luxury closer to everyday life. Her latest collection extends jewellery beyond the usual mediums, turning beauty products into fashion accessories in their own right.

data.title: Sala Sudasiri Sobha hosts Duo Baraldi from Italy
data.description: OLive Music presents "Roots And Migrations" by Duo Baraldi from Italy at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.

data.title: Oktoberfest comes to  One Bangkok Park
data.description: One Bangkok invites everyone to join "One Oktoberfest", a grand celebration inspired by Germany's iconic cultural festival at One Bangkok Park, Rama IV Road, from tomorrow to Sunday, starting from 4pm on weekdays and 2pm on weekends.

data.title: Trail venue boundaries come under scrutiny
data.description: The Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) is investigating whether a trail running venue in Nakhon Nayok's Ban Na district extends beyond its permitted boundaries or encroaches on state land.

data.title: Courts review sentencing rules for major offences
data.description: The Courts of Justice are setting up five subcommittees to review sentencing guidelines for major offences, including drug, technology, election, traffic, firearms, corruption and environmental crimes.

data.title: Dust-free rooms for at-risk groups
data.description: The government plans to establish 234 dust-free rooms for 6,077 vulnerable people in northern Thailand by next year to protect them from PM2.5 pollution, deputy government spokeswoman Patdarasm Thongsaluaykorn said.

data.title: Port have a mountain to climb in Johor
data.description: Port travel to Malaysia today seeking their first points of this season's AFC Champions League Elite, facing domestic powerhouse Johor Darul Ta'zim at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium (5pm Thai time).

data.title: Aimsaard sisters quit BAT, go solo
data.description: Women's doubles badminton players Nuntakarn Aimsaard and Benyapa Aimsaard have announced their decision to part ways with the Badminton Association of Thailand (BAT) to pursue their careers as independent athletes.

data.title: Senate approves Supreme Court judge for audit panel
data.description: The Senate approved Supreme Court judge Kajondej Janwattananon as a member of the State Audit Commission (SAC) in a 143-0 vote.

data.title: Lula win rattles Brazil markets over spending spree fears
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - The reelection of Brazilian leftist Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva rattled markets on Monday as investors, who had expected a win for his conservative rival, worried about fiscal discipline.
